notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF/bot-block, consistent with prior Home-Decor pass note; robots.txt has only a generic User-agent:* group, no Claude-specific disallow). Checked main nav (all hrefs on homepage), footer, sitemap.xml (576 URLs, no dedicated merch-PLP entries), and site search (/search/?q=...) for target terms plus 'arrivals'/'trending'. Found /products/news/ (nav label 'our new designs', <title>News</title>, h1 'our new designs') sitting as a peer top-level category alongside Lighting/Seating/Sofas/Storage/Tables/Accessories/Outdoor in the site's own plp-navigation swiper -- same PLP template/classes (plp-page, product-filter, bordered-grid, product-tile) as the verified working category pages from the prior pass. Every tile on the page carries an explicit productLabel {"text":"News"}. This is Muuto's genuine 'new products' merchandising listing, matching the brief's New Arrivals concept (page copy: 'our new designs' = newly added products, not a themed campaign/lookbook -- no editorial copy, just a standard filterable product grid). QTY: page has no client-side count widget/API (unlike the lighting/accessories category pages which use /api/products?pageId=... with hits/totalHits) -- this page is fully SSR with all tiles present at load, no 'load more'/pagination markup. Counted distinct product-tile master-id attributes (37, no duplicates) and cross-verified against the grid's own CSS order:N positions (37 distinct order values, 1-40 with gaps at 7/17/31 = 37 items) -- both methods agree exactly, so qty=37 is treated as exact per the site's own rendered grid (same exhaustion-check approach used successfully in the prior pass). No sub-structure: the News page has an active-filters UI shell but no default facet grouping/no genuine child listings (e.g. no 'New Lighting'/'New Furniture' distinct URLs found) -- single undifferentiated listing.
